purpose: Authored instruction calibration followed by a separately recorded same-state memory recall, not a held-out evaluation.

pick up the black bowl from table center and place it on the plate. First move the open gripper above the bowl at the center of the table, lower it around the rim, close the fingers, and lift the bowl. Then move it above the plate and open the gripper.
